# supervision

> One agent skill for AI video editing, motion graphics and design. Twenty-five
> open-source skill repositories distilled into one doctrine, one free local ffmpeg
> engine, and eight quality gates that measure a render before it ships. No API keys,
> no accounts, no telemetry. MIT.

Entry point for agents: `AGENTS.md` (Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, Cursor, Hermes) or
`skills/supervision/SKILL.md` (Claude, and any SKILL.md-compatible loader).

## Skills

- [supervision](skills/supervision/SKILL.md): router, twelve laws, precedence ladder for conflicting taste advice.
- [edit-supervisor](skills/edit-supervisor/SKILL.md): footage to publishable package — cutting, captions, grade, sound, delivery.
- [motion-director](skills/motion-director/SKILL.md): beat sheets, timing tables, transitions, three free render lanes.
- [design-director](skills/design-director/SKILL.md): art direction, systems and tokens, anti-slop tells with fixes.
- [ui-motion](skills/ui-motion/SKILL.md): interface animation — should-it-animate, springs, choreography, frame budget.
- [gatekeeper](skills/gatekeeper/SKILL.md): eight measured gates, the fix order, the fresh-context critic brief.
- [taste-memory](skills/taste-memory/SKILL.md): corrections become durable, appendable rules.

## Reference

- [specs/gates.json](specs/gates.json): the gate contract, machine readable.
- [specs/edl.schema.json](specs/edl.schema.json): the edit decision list schema.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): why judgement and measurement are split.
- [docs/lineage.md](docs/lineage.md): per-source credit, strength and gap.
- [docs/platforms.md](docs/platforms.md): how each agent consumes this repo.
- [examples/talking-head-to-short/walkthrough.md](examples/talking-head-to-short/walkthrough.md): a worked session, including the audit that failed first.

## Engine

`tools/sv.py` — one file, Python standard library plus an `ffmpeg` binary.
Commands: `doctor`, `probe`, `scaffold`, `validate`, `render`, `captions`, `gate`,
`sheet`, `demo`. `demo --selftest` proves the gates can fail.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every skill and reference concatenated, if your context window is generous.
